facts.fact: The government released N-ATLAS, an open-source language model for Yoruba, Hausa, Igbo and Nigerian-accented English, built by the National Centre for AI and Robotics with Awarri on Llama-3, and minister Tijani says it is already in use.
Minister Tijani says Nigeria is working with the Gates Foundation on a national shared computing facility.

systems.owner: National Centre for Artificial Intelligence and Robotics; Awarri
